prompt: Give me a status update on the checkout redesign. Facts: 7 of 11 tasks done (cart page, address form, shipping options, tax calc, promo codes, order summary, receipts). In progress: payment sheet (Sam, 60%), Apple Pay (Lee, 30%). Not started: guest checkout, analytics events. Blocked: none. Last week we finished 3 tasks; the week before 2. Release target is Nov 21.

Where do the four workstreams stand? Mobile app: on track, 80%, owner Ana, due Nov 15. API v2: at risk, 55%, owner Ben, due Nov 12, waiting on auth review. Docs site: done. Billing migration: blocked, 20%, owner Cy, due Dec 1, waiting for the payment provider's sandbox keys.

Summarize what happened overnight in this repo: 5 commits landed on main (2 bug fixes, a dependency bump, a new export feature, a test refactor), 1 PR was opened and is waiting for review, CI failed once on the e2e job and passed on retry, and 2 issues were closed.
How long until the migration finishes? It started 3 days ago with 4,800 records to move. Day 1 moved 900, day 2 moved 1,150, day 3 moved 1,020. About 1,730 remain.

We're working through this plan: 1. Extract the parser (done) 2. Add streaming support (done) 3. Port the renderer (in progress) 4. Add tests for edge cases (todo) 5. Update docs (todo). Tell me where we are.

I ran the test suite. The vitest JSON report is saved at $BB_THREAD_STORAGE/tests.json (142 passed, 2 failed: 'parse > handles empty input' and 'render > keeps focus after update', 3 skipped). Report the run to me.

Is the dark-mode feature done? Criteria: toggle in settings (passed, screenshot at $BB_THREAD_STORAGE/shots/toggle.png), follows system setting (passed), persists across restarts (passed), charts readable in dark (failed: axis labels too dim, screenshot at $BB_THREAD_STORAGE/shots/chart-dark.png), print styles unaffected (not tested).
I fixed the header layout bug. Before and after screenshots are at $BB_THREAD_STORAGE/before.png and $BB_THREAD_STORAGE/after.png. Show me the fix.

I re-rendered 6 screens after the redesign and saved before and after shots as $BB_THREAD_STORAGE/before/<name>.png and $BB_THREAD_STORAGE/after/<name>.png for: home, search, detail, cart, profile, settings. Three changed visibly (home, cart, settings); the rest are identical. Show me.

I optimized the list rendering. hyperfine results: before 412 ms mean, after 138 ms mean for 'render 1k rows'; before 1,880 ms, after 590 ms for 'render 10k rows'; before 95 ms, after 92 ms for 'initial mount'. Report it.
What's the state of my pull request on this branch? Is it ready to merge?

The CI run failed. I saved `gh run view 4821 --json name,displayTitle,status,conclusion,jobs,url` to $BB_THREAD_STORAGE/run.json. Jobs: lint passed, unit tests passed, e2e failed at step 'checkout flow', build passed. Tell me what failed.
What did I change on this branch so far?

Track the 3.2.0 release for me. I'm writing its state to $BB_THREAD_STORAGE/release.json as it moves: tag pushed, iOS build 512 uploaded and processing, Android build 512 in review, web deployed to staging, production deploy waiting for approval.
The build failed. The full output is at $BB_THREAD_STORAGE/build.log (exit code 2). The error is a type error in src/api/client.ts line 88. Show me.

Help me pick a database for the new service. Postgres: mature, great tooling, needs ops. SQLite with Litestream: simplest, single node, cheap. DynamoDB: scales without ops, awkward queries, vendor lock-in. We care most about simple ops, then query flexibility, then cost.

Where did the disk space go? I measured: node_modules folders 38 GB across 41 projects, Xcode DerivedData 24 GB, Docker images 19 GB, simulator runtimes 15 GB, caches 6 GB, everything else 12 GB. The disk is 500 GB with 41 GB free.
How much have we spent on the model evals this month against the $300 budget? Spend by day so far: Nov 1 $22, Nov 2 $41, Nov 3 $18, Nov 4 $63. Split: grading $58, agent runs $79, embeddings $7.
Our p95 API latency for the last 8 releases was 640, 655, 610, 720, 590, 560, 540, 515 ms. Release 4 shipped the new cache, which got rolled back and re-landed in release 5. What's the trend?

Here is the plan I want you to approve: 1. Add a feature flag (low risk, 1 h) 2. Migrate the settings table (high risk, 3 h, files db/migrations/042.sql) 3. Ship the new settings screen behind the flag (medium risk, 4 h) 4. Remove the old screen after a week (low risk, 1 h). Lay it out for my approval.

You are coordinating a stack of four pull requests for a settings redesign while workers fix review comments. Since your last message: #7254 Settings was fixed in 895b857 and you replied on the PR; the spec change is committed on the proposal branch; #7206 Calendar is still being reworked by a worker (header controls moving into the toolbar), you are waiting for its screenshots; #7255 Resources has one new review finding about records that haven't synced yet. Write your update to the person now.

Three worker threads you started just reported back. Search filters: done, PR #88 open, 64 tests pass. Export to CSV: done, PR #89 open, 41 tests pass, one flaky test retried. Bulk edit: failed, the worker hit a type error in src/grid/selection.ts it couldn't resolve and stopped. Tell the person where things stand and what you'll do next.

The reviewer's second round on your branch came back and you've handled it: missing null check in parser.ts (fixed), race in the cache refresh (fixed, with a new test), naming of the config flag (declined: matches the existing API), slow regex on large inputs (fixed, 40x faster), docs typo (fixed). Report back to the person.

You're midway through migrating 6 services to the new logging library. Done: auth, billing, search. In progress: notifications (tests running). Not started: reporting, admin. Billing needed an extra adapter for its structured fields. Post a quick progress update before continuing.

Before I build the new dashboard theme, help me pick its palette. Options: Ember (charcoal #17110E, text #F2E6DC, orange accent #FF7A3D), Slate (green-gray #0F1513, text #E3ECE8, teal accent #2BB3A3), and Paper (off-white #FAF7F2, text #1E1B18, blue accent #2F5BD3). I need to see them to choose. I'll wait for my pick before you continue.

We can only do three of these next sprint: offline mode, CSV export, SSO, dark mode, push notifications, faster search. Let me put them in order of priority, then you'll plan the sprint from my top three.
Something looks off on the settings screen but I can't describe it well. The screenshot is at $BB_THREAD_STORAGE/settings.png. Let me point at the problems on it so you know exactly what to fix.

I wrote the spec for the import feature at $BB_THREAD_STORAGE/import-spec.md (sections: Goals, Non-goals, File formats, Error handling, Rollout). I want to read it and leave comments section by section, then approve it or ask for changes. Set that up and wait for my review.
Let me choose the accent color for the app myself. It sits on a white surface (#FFFFFF) and on the dark surface (#16161D), so I want to see contrast on both while I pick. Wait for my color.

I captured the onboarding flow on every platform after the redesign: welcome, permissions and done screens, each on iPhone, iPad and Mac, in light and dark. The files are $BB_THREAD_STORAGE/shots/<screen>-<device>-<theme>.png (for example welcome-iphone-dark.png). The Mac dark done screen failed to capture. Show me the result.

Compare release 4.2 with 4.1: cold start 1,840 ms then 1,210 ms, app size 48.2 MB then 51.9 MB, crash-free sessions 99.1% then 99.6%, test count 517 then 529, memory at launch 212 MB then 198 MB. Did it get better?

Here are our eval scores for five prompt cases across four runs (case: run1, run2, run3, run4): summarize 88 91 86 90; extract 72 65 70 68; classify 95 96 94 97; translate 81 79 52 80; plan 60 74 71 69. Which cases are flaky and where did a run go wrong?
Check whether our brand colors are readable: Brand #4860E2, Success #1F9D55, Warning #E8A317, Muted text #8A8A99, on white #FFFFFF and on our dark background #16161D. Which ones fail AA?

I'm starting the 40-minute database backfill now. It rewrites $BB_THREAD_STORAGE/backfill.json as it goes ({"done": 0, "total": 120000, "label": "Rows", "eta": 2400}) and logs to $BB_THREAD_STORAGE/backfill.log. Keep its progress in view while we keep talking about other things.
I keep the fleet's status card in $BB_THREAD_STORAGE/fleet.iris and rewrite it whenever a worker reports. Show me that card here so it stays current as the file changes.
